name: Lion Central (Enrollment Services)
summary: Start here with enrollment questions, records and signing up for classes.

name: Admissions
summary: Apply to Wallace State and send in your new student documents here. Staff can help you get started.

name: Campus Tours and Recruiting
summary: Want to see the campus first? Book a free tour and meet the recruiting team.

name: Dual Enrollment
summary: High school students can take college classes and earn credit early. The number listed here is the Career Academy contact for Hanceville, Fairview, Holly Pond and nearby schools.

name: Financial Aid
summary: Get help with the FAFSA, grants and other aid that can lower the cost of school.

name: Scholarships
summary: The Future Foundation offers more than 150 scholarships for new and current students. You apply online after you enroll.

name: Cashier's Office
summary: Pay tuition and fees or ask questions about your bill.

name: Advising and Center for Student Success
summary: Advisors help you pick classes, plan your path and stay on track to finish.

name: Free Tutoring Lab
summary: Get free help with subjects like math, English, science and more.

name: Testing Center
summary: Take placement tests and other exams on the 4th floor of the Bailey Center. Call ahead to book a time.

name: Library
summary: Find books, research help and quiet study space. The library is open some evenings and Saturdays.

name: Accessibility and Disability Services
summary: Students with disabilities can ask for classroom accommodations here. Applying for accommodations is separate from applying to the college.

name: TRIO Student Support Services
summary: This program gives extra support to students who qualify, helping them stay in school and graduate.

name: Career Services
summary: Get help with resumes, job searches and work based learning.

name: Workforce Development
summary: Short training programs help adults build job skills for local employers.

name: Adult Education and GED
summary: Free help for adults who want to earn a high school equivalency diploma and build basic skills.

name: Mental Health Counseling
summary: Students can get free, private counseling in person or online. An after hours crisis line is also available at (256) 783-2014.

name: Lions' Kitchen Food Pantry
summary: A free food pantry for all Wallace State students, located in the Student Center.

name: Wallace State Cares
summary: Not sure where to start with a personal need? This team can point you to the right help.

name: Veterans Services
summary: Veterans, service members and their families can get help using VA education benefits.

name: Campus Police
summary: An officer is always on duty to keep campus safe. For emergencies, call 911.

name: Campus Housing
summary: Wallace State has residence halls for men and women within walking distance of classes.

name: Bookstore
summary: Buy or rent textbooks and grab Wallace State gear.

name: Student Engagement
summary: Find clubs, activities and ways to make friends on campus.

name: Dental Clinic
summary: Wallace State runs a dental clinic on campus. Call to ask about services and appointments.

name: Burrow Museum
summary: The Evelyn Burrow Museum shows porcelain, pottery, glass and bronze from its collection of more than 5,000 pieces, plus visiting art exhibits. It's open Tuesday through Friday.

name: Burrow Center for the Fine and Performing Arts
summary: Home to Wallace State music and performances that are often open to the community.
